articles.summary: The new platform brings together fiat and stablecoin capabilities, making it easier to move and manage any form of money. Mastercard and BVNK today announced the launch of Mastercard Global Money Platform, bringing together Mastercard’s global payments capabilities with BVNK’s stablecoin infrastructure through a single API . The launch marks the first major integration of Mastercard and BVNK capabilities since the acquisition of BVNK in August 2026. Global Money Platform provides a full-stack, modular infrastructure layer for modern finance. Banks, fintechs and enterprises can now embed multi-currency accounts, including fiat and stablecoins, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards and local bank payouts through Mastercard Move into their own products and under their own brand. They can also use the platform to manage their own treasury, payments and settlement activity directly. articles.summary: Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced its participation in the following investor conferences in November: On Monday, November 9, Ed McLaughlin, president and chief technology officer, will present at Citi’s 15 th Annual FinTech Conference in New York. The discussion will begin at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 35 minutes. On Tuesday, November 10, Linda Kirkpatrick, chief services officer, will present at KBW’s 2026 Fintech Ecosystem Conference in New York. The discussion will begin at 3:25 p.m. Eastern Time and last for approximately 40 minutes. There will be a live audio webcast of the discussions and replay will be archived for 30 days at investor.mastercard.com .
